issues.desc: From 1998-02-28 to 1998-03-02 외교통상부 had no minister. Contemporaneous reports say the heads of the seven reorganized ministries were automatically dismissed when 정부조직법 법률 제5529호 took effect on 1998-02-28, so 유종하's 외무부 spell ends 1998-02-27 and no 외교통상부 spell is created for him. The 외교부 역대 장관 page and ko.wikipedia run his tenure to 1998-03-03. offices.json leaves this legal reading to the researcher.

Spells starting before 2001 (유종하 1996, 박정수 1998, 홍순영 1998, 이정빈 2000) have no digital gazette. Their dates rest on news of the day (Naver-hosted 연합뉴스, BigKinds metadata) and the 외교부 page. 이정빈's start is 2000-01-14 (임명장) although the news of 01-13 reports the appointment on the day of the announcement.

No appointment notice was found in the gazette for 강경화, appointed 2017-06-18 (인사 index 2017-06-16..07-10 and full issues 2017-06-19..07-31 checked). Start rests on news and the 외교부 page, bounded by her countersignature as 외교부장관 in 관보 제19034호 (2017-06-21).

Two handovers are ambiguous at day level. 정의용's last day is set to 2022-05-12 (same-day handover) because news says he stayed until his successor's appointment that morning, while the 외교부 page gives 2022-05-11. 조태열's last day is 2025-07-18 per the 외교부 page, the successor's 재가 was on the evening of 07-18 and his appointment is dated 07-19 in the gazette.
The name of the 외무부 차관 who kept the ministry running 1998-02-28..03-02 was not identified. For 2004-01-16, 차관 김재섭 answered for the ministry, but no formal 직무대행 designation was found.

Several secondary-source disagreements were resolved in favour of the gazette or news. The 외교부 page gives 윤영관's end as 2004-01-17 (news says the resignation was accepted on 2004-01-15) and 조태열's start as 2024-01-12 (gazette 2024-01-10). ko.wikipedia gives 최성홍's start as 2002-02-05 (gazette 2002-02-04) and 조현's as 2025-07-18 (gazette 2025-07-19).

The old panel, used as a lead only, has these errors for this lineage. 이정빈 and 최성홍 are missing, and it has 송민순 start 2006-11-17, 유명환 end 2010-09-17, 윤병세 end 2017-03-10, 조태열 2024-01-11..2025-06-03. Transcript rows of invalid hearing types (본회의, 예결위, 국정조사) that place 강경화, 박진, 정의용, 윤병세, 반기문, 송민순 and 조태열 as 외교부장관 years outside their tenures were ignored.
Birth dates of persons who never sat in the National Assembly come from ko.wikipedia only (secondary).

Continuity check per ministry lineage found vacancy 1998-02-28..1998-03-02 between 유종하 (외무부) and 박정수 (외교통상부), same-day handover 1998-08-04 박정수 -> 홍순영, same-day handover 2000-01-14 홍순영 -> 이정빈, same-day handover 2001-03-26 이정빈 -> 한승수, same-day handover 2002-02-04 한승수 -> 최성홍, same-day handover 2003-02-27 최성홍 -> 윤영관, vacancy 2004-01-16..2004-01-16 between 윤영관 (외교통상부) and 반기문 (외교통상부), vacancy 2006-11-11..2006-11-30 between 반기문 (외교통상부) and 송민순 (외교통상부), same-day handover 2008-02-29 송민순 -> 유명환, vacancy 2010-09-09..2010-10-07 between 유명환 (외교통상부) and 김성환 (외교통상부), same-day handover 2013-03-11 김성환 -> 윤병세, same-day handover 2017-06-18 윤병세 -> 강경화, same-day handover 2022-05-12 정의용 -> 박진, same-day handover 2024-01-10 박진 -> 조태열. No overlaps were found. Every vacancy has an acting entry.

Verifier, cross-lineage consistency. The 2000-01-13 reshuffle (announced on the evening of 01-13, 임명장 on the morning of 01-14) is dated 2000-01-14 here and in the finance, industry, interior, land and oceans files, but 2000-01-13 in the education file (문용린). No gazette exists for 2000. The 2004-01-17 notice for 반기문 (announced 01-16, 임명장 01-17) shows that the gazette used the 임명장 date in a comparable case, which supports 2000-01-14.

Verifier. 정의용's end is marked disputed (2022-05-12 same-day handover kept, 외교부 page and both Wikipedias give 2022-05-11). The 외교부 page gives the day before the successor's start for three handovers (2021-02-08, 2022-05-11, 2025-07-18) and the same day for two (2017-06-18, 2024-01-10), so it follows no single rule.
